Definition: of uncertain derivation; Patmus, an islet in the Mediterranean:--Patmos.
BiblicalUsage: Patmos is an islet in the Mediterranean, the island where John receives the Revelation. John says in Revelation 1:9 that he is in the isle that is called Patmos, for the word of God, and for the testimony of Jesus Christ, and he is their companion in tribulation and in the kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Patmos is where exile became vision: John was banished for the word, and on the island the word was given to him in full.
